# Cove 1.5.0
- A smaller black island with two Home tiles, icon tabs, simpler controls, tinted pill buttons and prominent Start and Send buttons. - Show a followed game’s score alongside playing music in the compact island. - Finished games drop out of the followed strip and compact notch; one-off watched games are cleared when they end. - Nori has richer expressions: thinking glances, springier landings and spins, attention pings, sighs and occasional sleepy peeks. Static list avatars and Reduce Motion remain supported. - Retains sports Gamecast, favorites, screenshot editing and undo, existing local Codex chat prompts, attention fixes, optional device and cloud activity, and signed in-app updates.
Update through Settings → About → Check for Updates. Your existing Cove installation updates in place.
